==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tianheng:''' Hmm?
:'''Tianhe:''' Um... Does he mean "What's your business at the Vanguard Base"?
:{{DIcon}} Vanguard Base?
:'''Tianheng:''' Hmph.
:'''Tianhe:''' He means "If you have nothing to do, don't loiter around here".
:'''Tianhe:''' I'm sorry! My brother can be a bit rude... Let me explain for him!
:'''Tianhe:''' The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outrider, Vanguard, and Rearguard, all under the command of General [[Jiyan]].
:'''Tianhe:''' The Vanguard is the vanguard force of the Midnight Rangers, mainly responsible for frontline combat. This is the Vanguard Base.
:'''Tianhe:''' We are very close to the frontline here, and there are often [[Tacet Discord]] sightings around. If you have nothing important, please do not linger around, especially do not proceed further to the east.
:{{DIcon}} Has the situation on the battlefield become more intense?
::'''Tianhe:''' Although he doesn't talk much, he is very dedicated to his work and skilled, which is why General Jiyan specifically appointed him to guard this place.
::'''Tianhe:''' Hmph, with the two of us, the Vanguard Base is impregnable!
:{{DIcon}} How do you understand what he's saying?
::'''Tianhe:''' That's right, even some of the soldiers who were originally stationed at the base have recently been deployed to the battlefield...
::'''Tianhe:''' In order to defend this place, we can't leave our posts to ensure your safety, so please stay away from the front lines as much as possible.
::'''Tianhe:''' Ah... Well, we grew up together, so even without words, I can understand what he means just from his expression.
{{Dialogue End}}
